$comment: GET /v2/conferenceRecords -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. Past (and the current, if one is live) conferences, optionally filtered to one space. Google's filter grammar is its own (space.name = "spaces/{id}"), passed through verbatim -- this action does not attempt to build it from separate fields, matching how facebook-lead-ads and others pass a provider's own query language through rather than half-reimplementing it.
title: List conference records
description: List past conferences, optionally filtered to one space.

config.label: Filter
config.description: Google's filter grammar, e.g. space.name = "spaces/abc123" to see one space's history, or space.meeting_code = "abc-defg-hij". Leave blank for every conference the account can see.

config.label: Page size
config.description: Records per page. Leave blank for Google's default.

outputShape.description: This page's records, each with name (conferenceRecords/{id}), startTime, endTime, expireTime and space (the spaces/{id} it belongs to).
Present when there is another page.
